# Session C, row G4 (docs/gpu-experiments/03-acceleration/02-local-gpu-split.md): the fence knobs (I4), one at a time
# on the 2-layer graph, each with the boundary compare (the ids alone would not catch a stale line): a knob that
# passes the compare and cuts the event gaps stays on. The sleep at 8, 32 and 127 (the default is 1). Run after G3.
# One define per --runtime-flags, in the = form (the queue splits a row on whitespace; no quotes; argparse
# reads a value starting with a dash as an option unless it is attached with =).
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears table continue
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_COMPLETION_FENCE compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_COMPLETION_FENCE table continue
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_ACQUIRE_FENCE compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_ACQUIRE_FENCE table continue
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_BCAST_CAS compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_BCAST_CAS table continue
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_LOCAL_CAS compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_NO_LOCAL_CAS table continue
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=8 compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=8 table continue
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=32 compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=32 table continue
--layers 2 --iters 1 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=127 compare continue    # the boundaries at decode step 0 (a 32-iteration run holds iteration 31's values)
--layers 2 --iters 32 --event-timing --worker-timing --tile-linears --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=127 table continue
